control.description-key: PBS Hub schedule board, session detail, single create and bulk or AI schedule upload.

data-set.name: schedules
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Schedule - PBS Hub list filtered to the selected period. Columns: Title, Date, BrandID, StudioID, HostID, Account, Platform, Shift, Sesi, StartTime, EndTime, JamLive, Status, CampaignName, TotalAccount, Position, LiveBreak.

data-set.name: brands
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Brand - PBS Hub list. Columns: ID, Title, BrandID (if present), NamaBrand, Status.

data-set.name: accounts
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Account - PBS Hub list. Columns: Title, AccountName, BrandID, Platform.

data-set.name: studios
data-set.description-key: Bind to the Studio - PBS Hub list. Columns: Title, NamaStudio, KapasitasHost, Status.

data-set.name: hosts
data-set.description-key: Bind to ShowColumns of Host - PBS Hub with ID, Title, HostID (if present), NamaHost, HostName, Status only. Never bind KTP or bank columns.

data-set.name: reports
data-set.description-key: Optional. Report - PBS Hub for the same period. Locks a session and fills the report step. Columns: Title, ScheduleID, HostID, AccountID, Platform, LiveDate, Penjualan, Pesanan, TotalViewer, ApprovalStatus, Match, ApprovalComment.

data-set.name: absences
data-set.description-key: Optional. Host Absence - PBS Hub for the same period. Columns: Title, ScheduleID, HostID, Status, Keterangan, LiveDate.

data-set.name: clockins
data-set.description-key: Optional. ShowColumns of Clock In - PBS Hub with Title, HostID, ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime, ClockInTime, ClockOutTime, IsInsideGeofence, CheckInOffice, Status. Never bind GPS or selfie columns.

data-set.name: evidence
data-set.description-key: Optional. Report Automation - PBS Hub for the same period. Columns: Title, ScheduleID, Status, Penjualan, StartHour, EndHour.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON array fallback for the schedules dataset. A non-empty value wins over the dataset.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON: { userEmail, userName, roles, permissions, config }. Never carries row data.

property.name: Mode
property.description-key: Admin can create, edit, delete and upload. ReadOnly only views.

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: JSON reply from canvas: { requestId, status: ok or error, message, data }.

property.name: SelectedScheduleId
property.description-key: ScheduleID of the open session, blank for the board. Set it to deep-link.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON intent emitted by the control: { action, requestId, payload }. Handle it in OnChange.
